args.body: Read the committed runner-corrected-smoke.json before judging the trial. Verify the clean run includes the existing verifier's successful checks against the generated output and the negative run retains the style-level finding. If both pass, finish the bilingual operator demo and compare every setup prerequisite with L71. One fewer command establishes only that specific saving. Document file provenance and any added placement burden. If a check fails, inspect its actual output and preserve the failed result. Close under valid ownership after readback with a lesson covering the missing verifier arguments, the control that worked and what to check first next time. No deployment. Any later public release requires host-enforced independent review.

description: The catalogue transform produced the expected bytes, but the clean run exited 2 because the wrapper called the verifier without its required file arguments. The duplicate case produced the expected style-level finding. Correct the verifier call and rerun both controls before judging whether one command improves on the verified seven-download, two-command workflow. Commercial feedback has five unclassified sources and no attributable requests in the supplied snapshot, so demand remains unknown. Verified available funds and verified revenue are both zero.
